svg.title: Retry, wait or replan
svg.desc: Decision chart. A red Mismatch box leads right to the question Goal changed? Yes goes up to Replan (blue, tag 1). No goes right to Device down? Yes goes down to Another free?, whose yes goes left to Replan (blue, tag 2) and whose no goes down to Wait, watch (gray, tag 3). Device down? no goes right to Plan holds? Its no goes up to Replan (blue). Its yes goes down to Retries left?, whose yes goes down to Retry action (gray, tag 4) and whose no goes left to Replan (blue).
